note: The stress set: 72 questions on the 22-table schema (core plus extension). Patterns follow what published enterprise text-to-SQL benchmarks single out as hard: many-table joins, window functions, multi-step CTEs, correlated subqueries, set operations, conditional aggregation, date bucketing, business definitions given in the question, and schema linking among confusable tables (Spider 2.0, BEAVER, BIRD, the SQL-of-Thought error taxonomy). Gold answers come from executing gold_sql on the seeded database.

questions.question: Which carrier delivered the most orders to Platinum-tier customers? Show the carrier code and the number of delivered orders.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' AND s.ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY s.carrier_cd ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: For each product category, how many units were taken out of stock at the Rotterdam Hub warehouse? Show the category code and the units as a positive number.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(-m.qty) FROM inv_move m JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = m.sku JOIN warehouse w ON w.wh_id = m.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Rotterdam Hub' AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY p.categ_cd
questions.tests: stock movements, sign convention, warehouse by name

questions.question: List the names of customers who used the promotion code WELCOME10 on an order that later had an approved refund request. Show each customer once.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM ord_promo op JOIN promo p ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN refund_req r ON r.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE p.promo_cd = 'WELCOME10' AND r.status_cd = 'A'

questions.question: Which employees approved refunds on orders placed by customers in the EU region? Show the employee name and how many refunds they approved there.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.emp_nm, COUNT(*) FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = r.approver_emp_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'EU' AND r.status_cd = 'A' GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.emp_nm
questions.tests: four tables, approver is the employee on the refund row

questions.question: For delivered shipments only, what is the average number of days between the ship date and the delivery date for each warehouse? Show the warehouse name and the average rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT w.wh_nm, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(s.deliv_dt, s.ship_dt)), 1) FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON w.wh_id = s.wh_id WHERE s.ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm
questions.tests: date difference between two shipment dates, not order date

questions.question: How many distinct customers have both a support ticket that is still open and an order whose shipment is still in transit?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.cust_id) FROM support_tkt t JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.cust_id = t.cust_id JOIN shipment s ON s.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE t.closed_ts IS NULL AND s.ship_status = 'I'
questions.tests: two different 'status' columns on different tables

questions.question: What is the total list-price value of all units currently on hand in warehouses that serve the EU region? Use the product list price.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty * p.list_prc) FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE w.region_cd = 'EU'

questions.question: Which suppliers are the primary supplier of at least one product that has never been ordered? Show the supplier names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_nm FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_line l WHERE l.sku = ps.sku)

questions.question: For each region, which customer has the highest total value of delivered orders placed in USD? Show the region code, the customer id and the total.
questions.gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT c.region_cd, c.cust_id, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS tot FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_status = 'D' AND o.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY c.region_cd, c.cust_id), r AS (SELECT t.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_cd ORDER BY tot DESC) AS rk FROM t) SELECT region_cd, cust_id, tot FROM r WHERE rk = 1
questions.tests: top 1 per group with a window function

questions.question: For customer C-1038, show each order id with the running total of order values up to and including that order, in order date order with ties broken by order id. Ignore currency differences.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ord_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS running FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1038' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

questions.question: What is the largest gap in days between two consecutive orders of the same customer? Show the customer id and the gap, and break ties by customer id.
questions.gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT cust_id, DATEDIFF(ord_dt, LAG(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id)) AS gap FROM ord_hdr) SELECT cust_id, gap FROM g WHERE gap IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gap DESC, cust_id LIMIT 1

questions.question: What share of all 2026 orders was placed in each month of 2026? Show the year-month and the percentage rounded to one decimal, oldest month first.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ym, ROUND(100 * n / SUM(n) OVER (), 1) FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY ym) t ORDER BY ym
questions.tests: percent of total with an empty OVER

questions.question: For every product category, list the two products with the most units ordered. Show the category code, the product name, the units and the position (1 or 2), ordered by category code and position; break ties between products by product name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, units, rn FROM (SELECT p.categ_cd, p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) AS units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY SUM(l.qty) DESC, p.prod_nm) AS rn FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd, p.sku, p.prod_nm) x WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY categ_cd, rn
questions.tests: ROW_NUMBER over an aggregate, top 2 per group

questions.question: For each ticket category, what is the median time to close in hours among closed tickets? For an even number of tickets use the average of the two middle values. Round to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT categ_cd, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, opened_ts, closed_ts) / 60 AS h, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, opened_ts, closed_ts)) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd) AS cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NOT NULL) SELECT categ_cd, ROUND(AVG(h), 1) FROM t WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2), CEIL((cnt + 1) / 2)) GROUP BY categ_cd
questions.tests: median needs row numbers and a count, MySQL has no MEDIAN

questions.question: For customers who signed up in 2026, show each customer's id, the id of their first order and the total of that first order. Order by customer id. Customers with no order are left out.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT o.cust_id, o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.cust_id ORDER BY o.ord_dt, o.ord_id) AS rn FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.signup_dt >= '2026-01-01') x WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY cust_id

questions.question: Among tickets assigned to an employee, what share of all assigned tickets does each employee hold? Show the employee id and the percentage rounded to one decimal, largest share first, ties by employee id.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT assigned_emp_id, ROUND(100 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS share FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_emp_id ORDER BY share DESC, assigned_emp_id

questions.question: Of the customers who placed an order before 2026-01-01, what percentage placed at least one order on or after 2026-01-01? Round to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: WITH early AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt < '2026-01-01'), late AS (SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01') SELECT ROUND(100 * COUNT(l.cust_id) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM early e LEFT JOIN late l ON l.cust_id = e.cust_id

questions.question: From the website and app events, how many distinct sessions viewed a product, added to cart, started checkout and purchased? Show the four counts in one row in that order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN session_id END), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CART' THEN session_id END), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' THEN session_id END), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN session_id END) FROM web_event
questions.tests: funnel over the large clickstream table

questions.question: Among customers with at least 3 orders, which one has the longest average gap in days between consecutive orders? Show the customer id and the average gap rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT cust_id, DATEDIFF(ord_dt, LAG(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id)) AS gap FROM ord_hdr), c AS (SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) + 1 AS orders, AVG(gap) AS avg_gap FROM g WHERE gap IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust_id) SELECT cust_id, ROUND(avg_gap, 1) FROM c WHERE orders >= 3 ORDER BY avg_gap DESC, cust_id LIMIT 1

questions.question: Using the monthly segment history, how many orders did customers in each segment place in October 2026? Use each customer's segment for the month of 2026-10-01. Show the segment code and the order count.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT h.segment_cd, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_segment_hist h ON h.cust_id = o.cust_id AND h.month_dt = '2026-10-01' WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND o.ord_dt < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY h.segment_cd
questions.tests: join to a history table at a single month

questions.question: What are the three most common pairs of different products bought together on the same order? Show the two product names (the one that sorts first alphabetically first) and the number of orders that contained both, ties broken by the first then the second product name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT a.prod_nm, b.prod_nm, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT l.ord_id, p.prod_nm FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku) a JOIN (SELECT l.ord_id, p.prod_nm FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku) b ON a.ord_id = b.ord_id AND a.prod_nm < b.prod_nm GROUP BY a.prod_nm, b.prod_nm ORDER BY n DESC, a.prod_nm, b.prod_nm LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which carrier has the highest on-time rate, where on time means delivered within 5 days of shipping? Count only delivered shipments. Show the carrier code and the rate as a percentage rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT carrier_cd, ROUND(100 * SUM(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) <= 5) / COUNT(*), 1) AS rate FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY rate DESC, carrier_cd LIMIT 1

questions.question: For each month of 2026, what was the net USD order value: the totals of non-cancelled USD orders placed that month minus the approved refund amounts requested that month on USD orders? Show the year-month and the net value, oldest month first.
questions.gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS v FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_status <> 'C' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym), r AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(r.rfd_amt) AS a FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr h ON h.ord_id = r.ord_id WHERE h.currency_cd = 'USD' AND r.status_cd = 'A' AND r.req_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ym) SELECT o.ym, o.v - COALESCE(r.a, 0) FROM o LEFT JOIN r ON r.ym = o.ym ORDER BY o.ym

questions.question: How many distinct customers moved from the REG segment in one month straight to the RISK segment in the very next month, according to the segment history?
questions.gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd, LAG(segment_cd) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY month_dt) AS prev FROM cust_segment_hist) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM s WHERE prev = 'REG' AND segment_cd = 'RISK'

questions.question: Which customers have placed an order whose total is above the average order total of their own region? Compare totals as stored, ignoring currency. Show each customer id once.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.cust_id FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o2 JOIN cust_master c2 ON c2.cust_id = o2.cust_id WHERE c2.region_cd = c.region_cd)

questions.question: Which products have been ordered by customers from all four regions? Show the product names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.prod_nm FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.region_cd) = 4

questions.question: Which tickets that are still open were opened by a customer who placed no order in the 30 days before the ticket was opened? Show the ticket ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.tkt_id FROM support_tkt t WHERE t.closed_ts IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = t.cust_id AND o.ord_dt >= DATE_SUB(DATE(t.opened_ts), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.ord_dt <= DATE(t.opened_ts))
questions.tests: NOT EXISTS with a date window per row

questions.question: Which customers have placed at least 5 orders but have never had a refund requested on any of their orders? Show the customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT o.cust_id FROM ord_hdr o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o2 JOIN refund_req r ON r.ord_id = o2.ord_id WHERE o2.cust_id = o.cust_id) GROUP BY o.cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

questions.question: For each warehouse, which product has the lowest quantity on hand? Show the warehouse id, the SKU and the quantity.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT i.wh_id, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i WHERE i.on_hand_qty = (SELECT MIN(i2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.wh_id = i.wh_id)
questions.tests: per-group minimum with a correlated subquery

questions.question: Which orders had a failed payment attempt followed later by a settled payment? Show the order ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.ord_id FROM payment f WHERE f.pay_status = 'F' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment s WHERE s.ord_id = f.ord_id AND s.pay_status = 'S' AND s.paid_ts > f.paid_ts)

questions.question: How many distinct logged-in customers viewed at least one product on the site that they have never ordered?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.cust_id) FROM web_event w WHERE w.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND w.cust_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o JOIN ord_line l ON l.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.cust_id = w.cust_id AND l.sku = w.sku)

questions.question: Which employees have never been assigned a ticket and have never approved a refund? Show their names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.emp_nm FROM emp e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM support_tkt t WHERE t.assigned_emp_id = e.emp_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refund_req r WHERE r.approver_emp_id = e.emp_id)

questions.question: List the customer ids that have ordered through the mobile app and through the website, but never in a store.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING SUM(channel_cd = 'APP') > 0 AND SUM(channel_cd = 'WEB') > 0 AND SUM(channel_cd = 'STR') = 0

questions.question: Which products were ordered before 2026-07-01 but not at all on or after 2026-07-01? Show the product names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.prod_nm FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE o.ord_dt < '2026-07-01' AND p.sku NOT IN (SELECT l2.sku FROM ord_line l2 JOIN ord_hdr o2 ON o2.ord_id = l2.ord_id WHERE o2.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01')

questions.question: Which regions have customers who raised tickets in every one of the five ticket categories? Show the region codes.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.region_cd FROM support_tkt t JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id GROUP BY c.region_cd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.categ_cd) = 5

questions.question: List the SKUs that appear on orders from customers in the EU region and also on orders from customers in the NA region.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.sku FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'EU' INTERSECT SELECT l.sku FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA'

questions.question: List the customers who have at least one approved refund and no denied refund. Show customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT o.cust_id FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id GROUP BY o.cust_id HAVING SUM(r.status_cd = 'A') > 0 AND SUM(r.status_cd = 'D') = 0

questions.question: Make one list, without duplicates within each source, of the customers who opened a ticket in October 2026 (source ticket) and the customers who placed an order in October 2026 (source order). Show the customer id and the source, ordered by customer id then source.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id, 'order' AS source FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY cust_id UNION ALL SELECT cust_id, 'ticket' FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-10-01' AND opened_ts < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY cust_id, source
questions.tests: UNION ALL with a literal column

questions.question: Which products were viewed on the website or app in October 2026 but were not ordered in October 2026? Show the SKUs.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND evt_ts >= '2026-10-01' AND evt_ts < '2026-11-01' AND sku NOT IN (SELECT l.sku FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND o.ord_dt < '2026-11-01')

questions.question: Which carriers have delivered orders to customers in all four regions? Show the carrier codes.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.carrier_cd FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE s.ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY s.carrier_cd HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.region_cd) = 4

questions.question: For each sales channel, show the number of delivered orders, the number of cancelled orders and the number of returned orders as three columns after the channel code.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_status = 'D'), SUM(ord_status = 'C'), SUM(ord_status = 'R') FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd

questions.question: For each customer tier code, show how many customers it has in each region as four columns in the order NA, EU, AP, LA.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT tier_cd, SUM(region_cd = 'NA'), SUM(region_cd = 'EU'), SUM(region_cd = 'AP'), SUM(region_cd = 'LA') FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd

questions.question: For each month from 2026-04 to 2026-10, how many tickets were opened at each severity? Show the year-month and four columns for severity 1, 2, 3 and 4, oldest month first.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(sev_lvl = 1), SUM(sev_lvl = 2), SUM(sev_lvl = 3), SUM(sev_lvl = 4) FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01' AND opened_ts < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

questions.question: For each payment method, what percentage of its payment attempts failed? Show the method code and the percentage rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT method_cd, ROUND(100 * SUM(pay_status = 'F') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM payment GROUP BY method_cd

questions.question: For each warehouse, how many products are at or below their reorder point and how many are above it? Show the warehouse id and the two counts in that order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt), SUM(on_hand_qty > reorder_pt) FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id
questions.tests: comparison between two columns of the same row

questions.question: For each promotion used on at least 5 orders, what share of those orders ended up cancelled or returned? Show the promotion code, the number of orders and the percentage rounded to one decimal, largest percentage first, ties by promotion code.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.promo_cd, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100 * SUM(o.ord_status IN ('C', 'R')) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct FROM ord_promo op JOIN promo p ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = op.ord_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY pct DESC, p.promo_cd

questions.question: How many orders placed in 2026 had a total in each band: under 100, from 100 up to but not including 500, from 500 up to but not including 1000, and 1000 or more? Ignore currency. Show the four counts in one row in that order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt < 100), SUM(ord_total_amt >= 100 AND ord_total_amt < 500), SUM(ord_total_amt >= 500 AND ord_total_amt < 1000), SUM(ord_total_amt >= 1000) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01'

questions.question: For tickets that are still open as of 2026-10-31 18:00:00, how many are in each age band, by severity? Bands: open under 3 days, 3 to 7 days inclusive, more than 7 days. Show the severity and the three counts, ordered by severity. Age is measured in whole 24-hour days from the opened time.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sev_lvl, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, opened_ts, '2026-10-31 18:00:00') < 3), SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, opened_ts, '2026-10-31 18:00:00') BETWEEN 3 AND 7), SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, opened_ts, '2026-10-31 18:00:00') > 7) FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL GROUP BY sev_lvl ORDER BY sev_lvl
questions.tests: age bands from a reference timestamp

questions.question: How many orders were placed in each calendar week of September 2026, where a week starts on Monday? Show the Monday date of each week and the order count, oldest week first. Include only orders dated in September.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_SUB(ord_dt, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(ord_dt) DAY) AS wk, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-09-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY wk ORDER BY wk

questions.question: On which day of 2026 were there the most distinct browsing sessions in the event log? Show the date and the number of sessions, and break ties by the earlier date.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DATE(evt_ts) AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS n FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND evt_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY n DESC, d LIMIT 1
questions.tests: distinct count over the large table

questions.question: For the first three quarters of 2026, how many orders were placed in each quarter, and what is the percentage change from the previous quarter? Show the quarter number, the count and the change rounded to one decimal; the first quarter has no change (NULL). Oldest quarter first.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT q, n, ROUND(100 * (n - LAG(n) OVER (ORDER BY q)) / LAG(n) OVER (ORDER BY q), 1) FROM (SELECT QUARTER(ord_dt) AS q, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY q) t ORDER BY q

questions.question: How many tickets were closed on the same calendar day they were opened?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND DATE(closed_ts) = DATE(opened_ts)

questions.question: For delivered shipments, what is the average number of days from the order date to the delivery date for each customer region? Show the region code and the average rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.region_cd, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(s.deliv_dt, o.ord_dt)), 1) FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = s.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE s.ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY c.region_cd

questions.question: How many customers placed their first ever order within 7 days of the date they signed up, counting the sign-up day as day 0?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.cust_id FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.signup_dt HAVING DATEDIFF(MIN(o.ord_dt), c.signup_dt) BETWEEN 0 AND 7) t
questions.tests: first event relative to another date

questions.question: Which hour of the day (0 to 23) has the most add-to-cart events in the event log? Show the hour and the number of events.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT HOUR(evt_ts) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' GROUP BY h ORDER BY n DESC, h LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the orders placed from 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-31 inclusive, how many have no shipment at all?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-10-18' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment s WHERE s.ord_id = o.ord_id)

questions.question: A repeat customer is a customer with at least two delivered orders. How many repeat customers are there, and what percentage of all customers with at least one delivered order do they make up? Show the count and the percentage rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' GROUP BY cust_id) SELECT SUM(n >= 2), ROUND(100 * SUM(n >= 2) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM d

questions.question: A shipment is late when it was delivered more than 6 days after it was shipped. How many late shipments does each carrier have? Show the carrier code and the late count, most late first, ties by carrier code. Include only carriers with at least one late shipment.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS late FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) > 6 GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY late DESC, carrier_cd

questions.question: A customer is at risk when they have placed at least one order but none in the 90 days up to and including 2026-10-31, that is none dated 2026-08-03 or later. How many at-risk customers are there in each tier? Show the tier code and the count.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.tier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-08-03') GROUP BY c.tier_cd
questions.tests: definition with exists and not exists

questions.question: The net value of an order is its total minus the sum of its approved refund amounts. Which three USD orders have the highest net value? Show the order id and the net value, highest first, ties by order id.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status_cd = 'A' THEN r.rfd_amt END), 0) AS net FROM ord_hdr o LEFT JOIN refund_req r ON r.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt ORDER BY net DESC, o.ord_id LIMIT 3

questions.question: A severity 1 ticket breaches its SLA when it took longer to close than the number of hours in the sla_hours_sev1 policy value in force on the day it was opened. How many closed severity 1 tickets breached their SLA?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt t JOIN policy_rule p ON p.rule_key = 'sla_hours_sev1' AND DATE(t.opened_ts) >= p.eff_from AND (p.eff_to IS NULL OR DATE(t.opened_ts) <= p.eff_to) WHERE t.sev_lvl = 1 AND t.closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.opened_ts, t.closed_ts) > CAST(p.rule_val AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * 60

questions.question: An active shopper is a logged-in customer with an add-to-cart event in October 2026. How many active shoppers also placed an order in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.cust_id) FROM web_event w WHERE w.evt_type = 'CART' AND w.cust_id IS NOT NULL AND w.evt_ts >= '2026-10-01' AND w.evt_ts < '2026-11-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = w.cust_id AND o.ord_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND o.ord_dt < '2026-11-01')

questions.question: The refund rate of a product is the units of it on orders that have an approved refund, divided by all units of it ordered, as a percentage. Among products with at least 20 units ordered, which has the highest refund rate? Show the product name and the rate rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.prod_nm, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refund_req r WHERE r.ord_id = l.ord_id AND r.status_cd = 'A') THEN l.qty ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.qty), 1) AS rate FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING SUM(l.qty) >= 20 ORDER BY rate DESC, p.prod_nm LIMIT 1
questions.tests: rate with a correlated condition inside an aggregate

questions.question: Stock cover in days is the quantity on hand divided by the average units taken out per day over the 30 days from 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-31 inclusive (OUT movements as positive units, divided by 30). Which product and warehouse pair has the lowest stock cover among pairs that had any OUT movement in that window? Show the SKU, the warehouse id and the cover rounded to one decimal.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, ROUND(i.on_hand_qty / (SUM(-m.qty) / 30), 1) AS cover FROM inventory i JOIN inv_move m ON m.sku = i.sku AND m.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE m.mv_type = 'OUT' AND m.mv_ts >= '2026-10-02' AND m.mv_ts < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty ORDER BY cover, i.sku, i.wh_id LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many shipments have been delivered?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D'
questions.tests: the shipment status, not the order status

questions.question: How many different orders have had at least one failed payment attempt?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F'

questions.question: What is the total amount of payments that were refunded after settling, counting only payments in USD?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'R' AND currency_cd = 'USD'

questions.question: How many units of the product named 'Aurora Kettle' are on hand across all warehouses right now?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.prod_nm = 'Aurora Kettle'

questions.question: How many units of the product named 'Aurora Kettle' have been ordered in total on all orders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l.qty) FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE p.prod_nm = 'Aurora Kettle'
questions.tests: ordered, not on hand or moved

questions.question: Which promotion was used on the most orders? Show the promotion name and the number of orders.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.promo_nm, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_promo op JOIN promo p ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm ORDER BY n DESC, p.promo_nm LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many different sessions viewed a product without being logged in?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND cust_id IS NULL

questions.question: Which warehouse received the most restocked units (IN movements) during 2026? Show the warehouse name and the units.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(m.qty) AS units FROM inv_move m JOIN warehouse w ON w.wh_id = m.wh_id WHERE m.mv_type = 'IN' AND m.mv_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND m.mv_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1
